changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_loan_transaction_relation (from_loan_transaction_id, to_loan_transaction_id, to_loan_charge_id, relation_type_enum, created_by, created_on_utc, last_modified_by, last_modified_on_utc) WITH RECURSIVE orphans AS ( SELECT lt.id, lt.loan_id FROM m_loan_transaction lt WHERE lt.transaction_type_enum = 26 AND lt.is_reversed = false AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_loan_transaction_relation r WHERE r.from_loan_transaction_id = lt.id AND r.relation_type_enum = 2 AND r.to_loan_charge_id IS NOT NULL) ), edges AS ( SELECT r.from_loan_transaction_id AS child_id, r.to_loan_transaction_id AS parent_id FROM m_loan_transaction_relation r WHERE r.relation_type_enum = 3 AND r.to_loan_transaction_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT cs.resource_id AS child_id, original.id AS parent_id FROM m_portfolio_command_source cs JOIN m_loan_transaction original ON original.loan_id = cs.loan_id AND cs.api_get_url = CONCAT('/loans/', original.loan_id, '/transactions/', original.id) WHERE cs.action_name = 'ADJUST' AND cs.entity_name = 'LOAN' AND cs.resource_id IS NOT NULL AND cs.resource_id <> original.id ), chain AS ( SELECT o.id AS orphan_id, o.loan_id, o.id AS ancestor_id, 0 AS depth FROM orphans o UNION ALL SELECT c.orphan_id, c.loan_id, e.parent_id, c.depth + 1 FROM chain c JOIN edges e ON e.child_id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.depth < 100 ) SELECT c.orphan_id, NULL, MIN(r.to_loan_charge_id), 2, orphan.created_by, orphan.created_on_utc, orphan.last_modified_by, orphan.last_modified_on_utc FROM chain c JOIN m_loan_transaction ancestor ON ancestor.id = c.ancestor_id AND ancestor.loan_id = c.loan_id AND ancestor.transaction_type_enum = 26 JOIN m_loan_transaction_relation r ON r.from_loan_transaction_id = ancestor.id AND r.relation_type_enum = 2 JOIN m_loan_charge lc ON lc.id = r.to_loan_charge_id AND lc.loan_id = c.loan_id JOIN m_loan_transaction orphan ON orphan.id = c.orphan_id GROUP BY c.orphan_id, orphan.created_by, orphan.created_on_utc, orphan.last_modified_by, orphan.last_modified_on_utc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.to_loan_charge_id) = 1
